With Fan-sama's passing,
there is much mourning
even among the refugees.

rows.label: tlk46320171_02_msg0002
rows.name:
She often came to comfort the people
here in place of His Holiness Malbeni
when he was busy.

rows.label: tlk46320171_02_msg0003
rows.name:
I only hope this doesn't cause the
protests against the Blade policies
to gain momentum...
